	ORDER_ID,
	LOCATION_ID,
	CUSTOMER_ID,
	SUBTOTAL_CENTS,
	TAX_PAID_CENTS,
	ORDER_TOTAL_CENTS,
	SUBTOTAL,
	TAX_PAID,
	ORDER_TOTAL,
	ORDERED_AT
) as (
    with

source as (

    select * from CDO_DEMO_DB.raw.raw_orders

),

renamed as (

        (order_total / 100)::numeric(16, 2) as order_total,

)
